submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at 35 GeV gave the highest efficiency in the simulation scan, 93.3%. L2 and L1 were lower at every threshold tested. The 4.0 us latency limit is a hard requirement, and it is NOT verified for any candidate. All three latency values are recorded as -1, which is a sentinel, and 3 candidates are flagged uncertain. I am recommending L3 as the best available choice, but it is provisional. Its latency on the Level-1 FPGA must be confirmed to be at or below 4.0 us before adoption. The 8 kHz rate constraint was not explicitly confirmed at 35 GeV either. The 35 GeV point is a refinement near the 30 to 40 GeV plateau, and it is not clear that the rate was checked there.
